column1: # One pattern per line: id <TAB> severity <TAB> class <TAB> Python regex (re.search on the kernel MESSAGE).
# The FIRST matching line wins, so specific patterns come before general ones. severity: crit | warn | info
# (info is counted and exported but never alerted on). ids are unique; kernwatch_parse.py refuses a bad catalogue.
# Classes: oom mem hung lockup oops io fs mce conntrack synflood net link clocksource audit segv
# --- crit: the node or the host is losing work right now
